name: Haggai
title: The Prophet of Temple Building
summary: Haggai prophesied after the return from exile in Babylon. His main message was to motivate the people to rebuild the temple, which had lain in ruins for 16 years. His four short sermons, all from the year 520 BC, led to the work on the temple being resumed and completed.

keyEvents.title: Call to Rebuild the Temple
keyEvents.description: Haggai confronted the people for building their own houses while God's house lay in ruins.

keyEvents.title: The People Obey
keyEvents.description: The leader Zerubbabel, the high priest Joshua, and all the people began working on the temple.

keyEvents.title: The Glory of the New Temple
keyEvents.description: Haggai prophesied that the new temple would be more glorious than Solomon's temple.

keyEvents.title: The Promise to Zerubbabel
keyEvents.description: Haggai gave a messianic promise that Zerubbabel's lineage would be like a signet ring to God.
